subject: Platform compliance intake: audit windows, BYO-KMS & SSO clarifications
messages:
From: Kamal Iqbal <kamal@medspring.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedSpring IT Security <security@medspring.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security questions for PoC — audit logs / retention / BYO-KMS

Hi Jordan / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Security team asked me to capture the initial list of things they need clarified for a short PoC (2–4 weeks). The spreadsheet attached has prioritized items; top-line asks are:

- Audit log granularity and retention options (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- Evidence we can provide for access/datum-level events (who/when/region).
- BYO-KMS: flow for key import, rotation, and escrow — what is supported for the hosted API?
- SSO integration specifics: token expiry, session traceability, and deprovisioning hooks.

Can you confirm owners for each item and whether you need additional info from our side? We need a short summary by EOD Friday so security can sign off on the PoC scope.

Attached: MedSpring_Security_Questions_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Kamal Iqbal
Lead Security Engineer — MedSpring
security@medspring.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kamal Iqbal <kamal@medspring.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security questions for PoC — audit logs / retention / BYO-KMS

Thanks Kamal — looping in product / infra / ops to triage. Quick read of the sheet attached and my suggested intake:

- Audit logs / retention: owner Karthik (infra/serving runtime). Need a short matrix: what we record (auth events, API calls, token data, KV cache events), default retention, and per-tenant extension options (30d / 90d / custom).
- BYO-KMS: owner Marissa + Priya (product + infra). We need to clarify supported modes for Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private. For hosted, confirm whether we support transient customer keys (wrapped by Redwood CMK) or require dedicated private deployments for customer key ownership.
- SSO / session traceability: owner Ben. Provide exact SAML/OIDC claims we surface and how session deprovisioning maps to audit events.

Can you each reply with a 1-paragraph answer and any short artifacts by EOD Thursday? If we can't meet that, propose a 30-min sync tomorrow.

Action: I will consolidate and send a single-page scope back to Kamal so they can sign the PoC.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kamal Iqbal <kamal@medspring.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security questions for PoC — audit logs / retention / BYO-KMS

Couple quick clarifications from an ops/logging perspective:

- What we capture: API request metadata (caller id, route, model, token cost), auth events (login, SSO token trade, refresh, revoke), and system-level infra events (node restarts, model rollouts). We do NOT surface raw prompt text to support teams unless customer opts into expanded evidence for a private deployment.
- Retention tiers: Hosted default = 30 days; Dedicated contract tiers can extend to 90/365 with an SLA; Private customers control their own retention. We can provide short-term export (zip of events) on request — typical turnaround 48–72 hrs.
- Evidence format: JSONL exports with per-event timestamps, region tag, and request ids. We have a standard schema (see internal runbook link).

Attaching a short capability summary: audit-capabilities-summary.md.

Notes / open: need to confirm whether MedSpring requires per-token payload logs (they mentioned token-level traceability) — that has cost and privacy tradeoffs; if required, we'll mark as PoC risk.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kamal Iqbal <kamal@medspring.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security questions for PoC — audit logs / retention / BYO-KMS

Adding product constraints and rollout notes:

- BYO-KMS: For Dedicated and Private, customers can supply a CMK and we perform a handshake for key usage and rotation. For Hosted API we currently only offer envelope encryption where customer keys can be integrated via partner-managed HSM (limited pilot). Full customer-managed key ownership in Hosted requires a product change (estimated Q4 work) or a short-term contractual carveout (we can simulate with a delegated flow).
- PoC suggestion: Scope the initial PoC to audit retention and SSO traceability only; BYO-KMS can be listed as stretch unless MedSpring needs key custody from day one.
- Tradeoffs: enabling token-level logs in Hosted increases token costs and may require opt-in in the control plane for privacy reasons.

I'll draft the short two-column scope: Required vs Stretch and circulate. Priya — can you confirm infra lead time for per-tenant retention profiles? Karthik — please flag any infra blockers for exporting evidence within 48–72 hrs.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
PM, Security Platform — Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kamal Iqbal <kamal@medspring.com>, MedSpring IT Security <security@medspring.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Claire Hsu <claire@compliancesvc.io>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security questions for PoC — audit logs / retention / BYO-KMS

Kamal / team — summary and next steps below. Thanks to the internal owners for quick replies.

Summary (one-pager to sign):
- Audit logs: Redwood will provide API/auth/system events with JSONL export. Hosted default retention = 30 days; Dedicated extends to 90/365 based on contract; Private customers control retention. (Owner: Ben)
- Evidence export: 48–72 hr export turnaround for the PoC. Exports include timestamps, request IDs, region, and auth identifiers. (Owner: Ben)
- SSO: We surface SAML/OIDC claims and will map deprovisioning to an audit event; session traceability will be included. (Owner: Ben)
- BYO-KMS: Supported fully for Dedicated/Private. Hosted: envelope encryption only; full customer-owned KMS in Hosted is a product change—treat as stretch for PoC. (Owners: Marissa / Priya)

Action items and owners:
- Ben Carter: Produce the JSONL schema and attach an example export by Mon, 07/27. (Ben)
- Karthik Iyer: Confirm whether region-tagged logs include AZ-level metadata and any export performance limits by Mon, 07/27. (Karthik)
- Priya Natarajan & Marissa Cole: Draft BYO-KMS fallbacks and a short note on contractual requirements for Hosted by Tue, 07/28. (Priya / Marissa)
- Jordan Blake: Consolidate and send final PoC scope doc to MedSpring after receiving the items above.

Kamal — can you confirm if MedSpring wants BYO-KMS listed as must-have or stretch for the PoC? If must-have, we will need to change the proposed PoC timeline. Also confirm preferred time for a 30-minute alignment call early next week (Mon/Tue).

Links and artifacts: drive folder with MedSpring artifacts (see related_links). I also attached a short proposal that outlines the BYO-KMS options: proposal-byo-kms.pdf.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
